Title: Create a new booking
Precondition: None - first case in the sequence.
Steps:
1. Send POST to {base_url}/booking with the headers and body.
2. Record the bookingid returned - reused in TC-API-02, 05, 06, 07, 08.
Expected Result: Status 200 OK. Response contains a numeric bookingid. The booking object in the response equals the request body exactly.

Title: Retrieve booking by ID
Expected Result: Status 200 OK. Response body equals the booking data submitted in TC-API-01.

Title: Retrieve a non-existent booking
Steps: 1. Send GET to {base_url}/booking/999999999 (an id that will never be real).

Title: Authenticate as admin
Steps:
1. Send POST to {base_url}/auth with the credentials body.
2. Record the token string - needed for TC-API-05, 07, 08.
Expected Result: Status 200 OK. Response contains a non-empty token field.

Title: Update booking with a valid token
Precondition: TC-API-01 and TC-API-04 complete; have bookingid and token.
Headers:
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: token=<token from TC-API-04>
Steps:
1. Send PUT to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid> with the headers and body.
2. Send a follow-up GET /booking/<bookingid> to confirm the change persisted.
Expected Result: PUT returns 200 OK with body equal to the updated payload. Follow-up GET also returns the updated data.

Title: Update booking with an invalid token
Request Body: Any valid booking payload (e.g. reuse the body from TC-API-01).
Steps: 1. Send PUT to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid> with a deliberately bogus Cookie token.
Expected Result: Status 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden. The booking's data is not changed.

Title: Partially update a booking
Precondition: TC-API-01 and TC-API-04 complete; have bookingid and token.
Headers:
Content-Type: application/json
Cookie: token=<token from TC-API-04>
Steps: 1. Send PATCH to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid> with the single-field body.
Expected Result: Status 200 OK. firstname is now "Patched"; every other field is unchanged.

Title: Delete a booking
Precondition: TC-API-01 and TC-API-04 complete; have bookingid and token.
Steps:
1. Send DELETE to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid>.
2. Send a follow-up GET /booking/<bookingid> to confirm it's gone.
Expected Result: DELETE returns 200 OK or 201 Created. Follow-up GET returns 404 Not Found.

Title: Authenticate with invalid credentials
Steps: 1. Send POST to {base_url}/auth with the wrong password.
Expected Result: Status 200 OK (API quirk) with body {"reason": "Bad credentials"}. No "token" field is returned.

Title: List all booking ids
Steps: 1. Send GET to {base_url}/booking with no filters.
Expected Result: Status 200. Body is a JSON list; every item has a "bookingid".

Title: Filter bookings by firstname and lastname
Precondition: TC-API-01 complete; note the firstname, lastname and bookingid.
Steps: 1. Send GET to {base_url}/booking with the firstname and lastname of the booking from TC-API-01.
Expected Result: Status 200. The list includes the bookingid from TC-API-01.

Title: Filter with no matches returns an empty list
Expected Result: Status 200 with an empty list [] (not an error).

Title: Write operations without a valid token are forbidden
Headers:
Content-Type: application/json
(Cookie omitted, or Cookie: token=, or Cookie: token=bogus)
Request Body: PUT: a full booking payload with firstname "Hacked". PATCH: {"firstname": "Hacked"}. DELETE: none.
Steps:
1. For each method (PUT, PATCH, DELETE) and each token variant (no Cookie header, empty token, bogus token), send the request to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid>.
2. Send GET to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid>.
Expected Result: Every request returns 403 Forbidden. The GET afterwards shows the booking exactly as it was created.

Title: Full update with missing fields is rejected
Precondition: TC-API-01 and TC-API-04 complete; have a bookingid and a token.
Request Body: Either a valid booking payload without firstname, or an empty object {}.
Steps:
1. Send PUT to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid> with the incomplete body.
2. Send GET to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid>.
Expected Result: Status 400 Bad Request. The GET afterwards shows the booking unchanged.

Title: Firstname filter is exact and case-sensitive
Steps:
1. Send GET to {base_url}/booking?firstname=Jim; confirm the bookingid is listed.
2. Send GET with firstname=jim (lowercase).
3. Send GET with firstname=Ji (partial).
Expected Result: Step 1 lists the bookingid. Steps 2 and 3 return 200 and do NOT list the bookingid.

Title: Combined filters must all match
Steps:
1. Send GET with only the booking's firstname; confirm the bookingid is listed.
2. Send GET with the same firstname and lastname=Nomatch.
Expected Result: Step 1 lists the bookingid. Step 2 returns 200 and does NOT list it (filters are ANDed).

Title: Patching one date keeps the other (KNOWN DEFECT)
Precondition: TC-API-01 and TC-API-04 complete; have a bookingid and a token.
Steps:
1. Send PATCH to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid> with only a new checkin date.
2. Send GET to {base_url}/booking/<bookingid>.
Expected Result: Status 200. checkin is updated to 2031-09-09 and checkout keeps its original value.
Actual Result: Status 200, checkin updated, but checkout is overwritten with "0NaN-aN-aN".

Title: Create with a missing required field is rejected (KNOWN DEFECT)
Request Body: A valid booking payload with the firstname field removed.
Steps: 1. Send POST to {base_url}/booking with firstname omitted.
Expected Result: Status 400 Bad Request (client error). No booking is created.
